description: Train a compact sidecar policy-ranker corpus with descendant, smoke-loss, and LC0-oracle rows.

baseline: desc74 held-out policy sidecar: val 5/18 -> 12/18, 8 good overrides, 0 bad
desc74 sidecar applied to the mixed 1533 corpus without retraining was harmful: val threshold 0 had 79 good and 169 bad overrides; threshold 4 had 7 good and 5 bad
first mixed sidecar run was confounded by a checkpoint-selection bug and saved the final epoch instead of the selected best epoch
r2 after the checkpoint fix still failed: val raw policy 203/383 versus base 210/383; threshold 4 had 3 good and 4 bad validation overrides
pass_intent: test whether lower-dimensional compact features avoid board-feature overfit on the moderate mixed corpus
require held-out top1 above the mixed-corpus base baseline
require useful held-out good overrides while bounding bad overrides
